summary.text: Rick Krajewski is a Democratic member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives for District 188, which he has represented since December 2020, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Krajewski earned a B.A. in electrical engineering from the University of Pennsylvania in 2013.
His career experience includes working as an organizer for Reclaim Philadelphia.
Krajewski assumed office in the House on December 1, 2020, succeeding James Roebuck Jr.
